evals.name: mos2-band-gap-skip-relax
evals.prompt: Calculate the PBE band gap of MoS2 from ./materials/MoS2-mp-2815.cif using DFT. The structure is from Materials Project so it's already relaxed — just do the static SCF and report the gap in eV (and whether it's direct or indirect).
evals.expected_output: band_gap.json with gap_eV in [1.0, 1.4] eV and direct=false (literature PBE MoS2 bulk ≈ 1.23 eV indirect).

evals.name: silicon-band-gap
evals.prompt: Compute the band gap of crystalline silicon from this CIF: /tmp/eval_cifs/Si-mp-149.cif. Run the VASP calculation on the cloud cluster and tell me the gap value in eV.
evals.expected_output: band_gap.json with gap_eV in [0.4, 0.8] eV and direct=false (PBE Si gap ≈ 0.6 eV indirect; experimental 1.17 eV).

evals.name: aluminum-metal-detection
evals.prompt: Is /tmp/eval_cifs/Al-mp-134.cif a metal or a semiconductor? Calculate the band gap to find out.
evals.expected_output: band_gap.json with gap_eV = 0 (or very close to 0) and the conclusion that Al is metallic.
